config.qa_repetition_policy: One full QA run first; additional full repetitions only within remaining cap. Never call a single repetition repeated evidence.
config.scope: Full official datasets; exact official rubric where available, GPT-6 Luna reader/judge variant. Not official leaderboard model parity.

additional_baselines.mem0: pending adapter and matched model config
additional_baselines.zep: must use an accessible self-hosted implementation; hosted results cannot count as same hardware
additional_baselines.dense-vector: Supermemory local bge path is an initial dense baseline; independent model version remains planned

config.failure_policy: All official questions count. API errors remain failures. Budget stop preserves incomplete run; incomplete run has no full-suite score.

protocol: Full official sources and official evaluators where available; GPT-6 Luna variant. LoCoMo additionally uses a declared matched-model judge. No official leaderboard model-parity claim.

budget.pricing: Conservative billed upper estimate, including potential cache-write premium; not an account invoice.

rate_policy: Shared conservative 150K estimated TPM / 400 RPM against verified account 200K TPM / 500 RPM
qa_status: Fresh full scoring; previous burst failures retained in parent raw outputs

qa_confidence_interval.method: 95% percentile bootstrap clustered by source history; 2000 resamples, seed 20261004
